OrbitCare · Research prototype

A personal record, not an isolated reading

Heart rate, sleep and fatigue align with a fixed reference. Exercise adds context. Four resettable synthetic scenarios make the demonstration reproducible.

2 / 7
OrbitCare · Research prototype

Every flag has an explanation

Reference, current value, original-unit difference, persistence, source context and uncertainty. Three-day rules are transparent engineering assumptions, not NASA clinical thresholds.

OrbitCare · Research prototype

Missing does not mean reassuring

Missing and non-comparable readings stay visible. They interrupt persistence rather than becoming zero or silently extending a sequence.

OrbitCare · Research prototype

Disconnect. Reload. Record a review.

Actual network disconnection and offline reload. A review was saved locally; nothing was sent to Earth. Offline readiness is verified separately from persistence.

5 / 7
OrbitCare · Research prototype

Real NASA observations, kept separate

OSD-575: 56 original sodium/potassium observations, four Inspiration4 participants, seven ground visits. Original units, source checksum and methodology preserved. No threshold calibration or invented in-flight telemetry.
